purpose: Own current Algebra 1 Portfolio status/rollup, Quick Check mechanics, evidence-source mapping, practice-link routing, and recurring report fidelity while Unit Assessment Plans own exact learning content.

mastered_default_rule.normal_requirement: At least two independent convincing demonstrations, normally from different opportunities, with at least one reasonably current demonstration.
mastered_default_rule.rich_artifact_exception: A rich artifact may be sufficient when it contains multiple genuinely independent convincing demonstrations.
mastered_default_rule.mixed_evidence: Teacher professional judgment resolves mixed or unusual cases.
mastered_default_rule.later_weak_event: One later weak event does not automatically remove established mastery; record the contradiction and seek another look when warranted.
mastered_default_rule.accommodations: Approved accommodations do not lower the evidence status of a valid demonstration.

mastery_goal_rule.demonstrated_when: At least 2 of 4 I Cans are Mastered or Transfer.

unit_scale.label: Mastery + Transfer
unit_scale.rule: 4 of 4 Mastery Goals demonstrated plus meaningful transfer/extension evidence

powerschool_rule: One living assignment per unit. Current official status replaces prior status; attempts are not averaged. Earlier Unit status may improve later when valid evidence demonstrates an older Unit I Can.

quick_check.live_selection_rule: Curriculum predicts evidence slots. Portfolio selects current reassessment I Cans from live need. Teacher approves/edits actual questions.
quick_check.mapping_rule: Map the clean task before judging handwriting. A task may provide separately judgeable evidence for more than one I Can when the task genuinely contains both evidence jobs; those judgments still share the same source opportunity unless independence is explicitly supported.
quick_check.same_source_rule: Repeated prompts for one I Can on the same Quick Check are not automatically independent opportunities. Source maps may require a single synthesized source-level judgment.
quick_check.teacher_selector_rule: The unit builder shows four slots with exact I Can choices and Bank-derived family possibilities. Live Portfolio need may guide reassessment recommendations when available; otherwise the eligible pool is shown. Teacher selection is final.
quick_check.teacher_note_rule: The unit builder includes an optional fine-tuning note beside the request action. It may tune surface/layout/value choices but may not silently change selected I Can, family evidence job, or difficulty.
quick_check.version_rule: Four versions A-D use the same four teacher-approved evidence architectures. Normal differences are simple number/value swaps, deterministic question-order scrambling, and answer-choice scrambling when applicable. Do not redesign questions merely to create versions.
quick_check.source_map_rule: For newly generated approved Quick Checks, the sibling approved quick_N_S.json is the primary exact lineage/source map. curriculum/quick_check_source_maps is reserved for legacy/special aggregation, multi-target overrides, compatibility, or missing approved JSON.

student_practice_link.portfolio_qr_rule: The printed Portfolio QR opens the Practice Builder with the selected exact I Can already checked. It does not point to the Student Bank.
student_practice_link.portfolio_target_priority: Prefer PRACTICE_AND_CHECK when current evidence shows a demonstrated gap. Do not choose NEEDS_FIRST_CHECK solely because evidence is absent when a demonstrated practice need exists. If no PRACTICE_AND_CHECK target exists, use the current next-target rule.
student_practice_link.privacy_rule: Practice Builder links contain Unit and I Can only; do not put student identity or evidence in the URL.
student_practice_link.student_bank_role: Legacy/reference viewer; not the Portfolio report QR destination.
student_practice_link.family_selection: Bank families remain curriculum/evidence architecture. The student Practice Builder does not expose Family A/B/C controls.

report_fidelity.rule: Registered Portfolio templates own recurring headings, table/card anatomy, QR block, and visual layout. Job 18 fills declared data slots and may not redesign or rephrase the report from run to run.
report_fidelity.student_recent_evidence_exception: The approved Recent evidence table may show the internal evidence word Convincing/Partial/Limited/Unusable as a compact evidence descriptor; do not expose unrelated internal mechanics or rubric metadata.
report_fidelity.teacher_name_rule: Use compact first-name + last-initial lists where needed. Group by period header when relevant; do not append period after every student name.
report_fidelity.student_action_rule: Use only the fixed student next-action vocabulary declared by the Portfolio template contract. Do not invent alternate action labels or generic coaching text.

teacher_summary.latest_evidence: Use approved 2 x 2 I Can cards. Combined first, then one page per period. Each latest-evidence card has one list: Students needing stronger or additional evidence; do not invent new evidence-category name buckets.
teacher_summary.longitudinal_sort: Final combined 2 x 2 page uses full Portfolio history and the fixed categories Reteach / Brief guided practice / Ready for another independent demonstration / No evidence / Review flags.
teacher_summary.contradiction_rule: A later weak event does not automatically demote established mastery; put meaningful conflict in Review flags for teacher judgment.

legacy_retirements: Not Yet / Approaching / Meeting / Exceeding as current Algebra Portfolio status labels
fixed previous-section Exit Ticket reassessment chain
Ticket A/Ticket B labels as current Portfolio source labels unless preserving a legacy printed alias for source matching
Student Bank as the printed Portfolio report QR destination

student_next_action.principle: I Can proficiency status and student next action are separate. Developing may mean practice + check soon OR another independent check, depending on the body of evidence.

states.label: Practice + check soon
states.rule: Developing without one convincing independent demonstration, or a clear current gap should be repaired before another independent check.

states.label: Needs another independent check
states.rule: Developing with one convincing independent demonstration but not yet enough independent convincing evidence for Mastered.

states.label: Secure
states.rule: Current I Can status is Mastered.

states.label: Extension
states.rule: Current I Can status is Transfer, or routine nearby targets are secure and a legitimate transfer/extension move is selected.

student_next_action.page_2_rule: Every I Can row shows one compact Next: label from the five states so students can distinguish practice-before-recheck from another-evidence-needed.
